premise: Duckling and Caterpillar think Bee is painting the flowers yellow, follow her from flower to flower, and find out she is carrying the yellow dust that helps flowers make seeds.
inspiration: A Just So-style question (Kipling), answered truly instead of tall: not how the flower got its colour, but what the bee is really doing.
lesson: Watching carefully shows you how the world works.
learning: Bees carry pollen from flower to flower, and that is how seeds begin

en-US.title: Following the Busy Bee
en-US.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {duckling:enter} Duckling {duckling:pulse} was curious about the {bee:enter} bee. She buzzed from {flower:enter} flower to flower, {bee:shake} and her fuzzy legs were covered in yellow dust. [curious] Is she painting them? asked {caterpillar:enter} Caterpillar. {caterpillar:face surprised} Let's follow her! So Caterpillar {caterpillar:hop} came along too. {sfx:buzz} Bzzz! Bee landed on a flower, {flower:wobble} and the yellow dust stuck to her legs. Bzzz! She flew to the next one, {bee:sparkle} and some of the dust fell off there. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] She's not painting! said Duckling. She's carrying it! {bee:face happy} {bee:hop} That's right, hummed Bee. {flower:face happy} This dust helps the flowers make seeds. {caterpillar:face happy} {duckling:face happy} [happily] So they followed her all afternoon, bzzz, {sfx:quack} quack, bzzz, {all:hearts} the busiest helpers in the meadow.

es-ES.title: Siguiendo a la abeja
es-ES.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {duckling:enter} Patito {duckling:pulse} tenía curiosidad por la {bee:enter} abeja. Zumbaba de {flower:enter} flor en flor, {bee:shake} y tenía las patitas peludas llenas de polvo amarillo. [curious] ¿Las está pintando?, preguntó {caterpillar:enter} Oruga. {caterpillar:face surprised} ¡Vamos a seguirla! Y Oruga {caterpillar:hop} se apuntó también. {sfx:buzz} ¡Bzzz! Abeja se posó en una flor, {flower:wobble} y el polvo amarillo se le pegó a las patas. ¡Bzzz! Voló a la siguiente, {bee:sparkle} y un poco de polvo se quedó allí. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] ¡No está pintando!, dijo Patito. ¡Lo está llevando! {bee:face happy} {bee:hop} Eso es, zumbó Abeja. {flower:face happy} Este polvo ayuda a las flores a hacer semillas. {caterpillar:face happy} {duckling:face happy} [happily] Así que la siguieron toda la tarde, bzzz, {sfx:quack} cuac, bzzz, {all:hearts} los ayudantes más ocupados del prado.
